description: four: the steward, the woman who owes (whose mother the Rose holds) and two estate men
BM&V's 'House' named the Chainbreakers' house; a carved post with broken chains by its front door (exterior door 15647F, at 32,-14), from BM&V's own Argonian statics

the estate's landing on the road north of the town: the steward Hulm-Tei's debt book in a chest on a low lock, owned by him, standing on the landing's navmesh in 095465 (no shed); the book added to the chest at stage 10; a trigger box where the channel leaves the estate
two Chainbreakers who shelter there, freed debtors, who keep the house

Never-Sold, a woman born owing who discharged it, a careful accountant who remembers every bought-out name, keeper of the Chainbreakers' house; she meets the player at the estate landing (095465); no escort
smoke and fire states under enable parents (smoke, burning, burnt) in the stone house 1307CF's one room, from BM&V's own pieces
the stone house's west side where the heirs' gate-keepers stand; no new gate is built
three of the heirs' held inside the stone house, and Third-Born Tsaxi and a second gate-keeper outside its west wall
Ussa-Rekh's chest on the dock planks beside him (a vanilla chest, placed on the planks' surface), on a low lock and owned by him, holding the crew's carved tokens from the start

Ussa-Rekh and one crew boss of a freed crew, Heavy-Rope, on the dock's navmesh; Heavy-Rope must be talked or paid into taking the refusal if the player stands with Ussa-Rekh; no other crew boss and no pickpocket route

description: one crocodile, our base 'Crocodile' templated on BM&V's Alligator base 0BCB00:Black Marsh.esm at a fixed level, in the shallows under the crew's plank walk on the landing (dock5, cell 0D77AF at -9,15, which has navmesh 1FAEB6), fixed band 1, under an enable parent (ref.lq25.beast) that LQ25's first stage turns on, with the offal and the crew's bait bucket (thing.lq25.bait) by the pilings under the same parent

BM&V's two villagers north along the shore from the ship's door, the man 08D5EE (-10,15) and the woman 08D5EF (-9,15), become the baiting crew, two Agaceph rafters, Okan-Zish and Wuleen-Taza; each is given a base of their own, templated on the shared one (00FF4D 'Villager', 02A1EE; the Talk names shape), and named so; the shared bases are never edited. Their rival is BM&V's own Boat Captain 08D5F1 (-9,19), unchanged, who speaks as Sells-Dear through a reference alias on 08D5F1

one viper (BM&V's Viper base 17BC83:Black Marsh.esm, which BM&V places in the basin's roots) among the roots in the shallows of cell 0D7883 (-5,18, navmesh, no NPCs) where the youth stands, fixed band, under an enable parent (ref.lq30.beast) that LQ30's first stage turns on

the way east from the gate along row 18 into the basin's shallows, BM&V's own terrain (root and shallows, no statics added), to the roots in cell 0D7883 (-5,18, which has navmesh 1FAE4C; 0D7885 east of it has none) where Sei-Wan and the viper stand, off the marsh way MQ05 uses between the landing and the gate; zone.lq30.gate at the gate

Sei-Wan, a young Argonian, among the roots in the shallows of the basin (cell 0D7883) and Haj-Wan, the youth's kin, by the gate, each a W-npc from a BM&V Argonian villager template; at either ending the youth is moved to mark.lq30.gate by the gate, once the player has left 0D7883

Buys-The-Months, the debt-labour broker, standing on the pier beside his ship at Hereguard Plantation's pier, west of Lilmoth (5350,-7800, Dock1's navmesh 079823), the one way off the ship, with no enable parent; his one package is the force-greet of MQ01's topic.mq01-not-on-roll, gated on MQ01 stage 10, with a greet radius that keeps him on the pier

three of the broker's Owing gang standing in the ship's hold on its navmeshed floor, one standing place each and no package: Wuleen-Sei, the broker's overseer; Ux-Xeek, his port hand; Dives-Without-A-Rope, washed out from years away from Nine Bends (MQ01, MQ03)
the hold cell's location is cleared of vanilla Skyrim's 'Dainty Sload' (07B91A:Skyrim.esm), so no Skyrim name shows in the hold
Valenwood.esp's start-game quests 0MainQuest1 and AANEWQuestM (0F0F3E) do not start until the player first enters Valenwood, so nothing of theirs reaches a Black Marsh opening
BM&V's greeting quest 01Captain ('Welcome to Black Marsh') does not start until MQ03 ends
a persistent start marker in the hold of the broker's ship; ARG_Opening points at it instead of the pier marker, so a new game opens there (character creation in the hold)

the house's outer door 0FE95A (a Riften model) and its inner side 0FE832 (a Whiterun model) take the base of BM&V's own Lilmoth house doors, so no Nordic model reaches the player through a door a quest sends them to (0006); never locked
Salts-The-Catch standing inside the door of her house and Nesh-Deeka standing at the far end of its room, on the house's navmeshed floor, one standing place each (MQ01, MQ03)

the cell's camp on a dry rise past the last stilt house, where the reeds bend, in cell 039793:Black Marsh.esm (ref.mq04.cell-camp, on from stage 10, off in every ending; BM&V's own Argonian statics) with the two cell men, Hides-His-Wake and Counts-The-Jars (npc rows cell-man-1 and -2, the knotted cord at the wrist, fixed level, band 2), cell-man-1 a sentry on the trail side; the camp is disabled in every ending

by the camp's fire, under the camp's enable parent (ref.mq04.cell-camp, on from stage 10): BM&V's own clay jars of sap with the tree-minder's knife in one bundle (thing.mq04.sap-jars, a quest item; the knife is BM&V's own Argonian knife, its edge black with gum), so one take gets both
BM&V's Leech and Giant Leech, a few at a fixed level, at the cut root (zone.mq04.root) and in the leech water the trail crosses; none on any path of the village
the Village named from the lore's Murkmire villages

three: the tree-minder Pays-Late (whose package takes him to the cut root after dark), the egg-tender Turns-The-Clutch, the root-herald Hires-By-The-Season on the platform at the Hist's foot; the root-herald's and egg-tender's gates are vanilla Speech checks of 25 (the root-herald's paid with two portions of any common food instead); after an adoption the root-herald gives a bed and food (service.low-reed-village.lodging) and the tree-minder's sap-balm heals (service.low-reed-village.healing); the cell men are we.mq04.cell

the village's Hist (BM&V's Hist static, if the cell has none) under withdrawn and reconciled enable parents (ref.mq04.withdrawn, ref.mq04.reconciled: the leaves part and the light comes back low), the closed tending-ground and its pools, a dark uxith, the cut root under the stilts (zone.mq04.root; cut at the ring, sealed with black gum), the sap-workshop with a new pale bar on its door and an empty knife-peg (zone.mq04.workshop), the far side of the leech water with bent reed stems and gum drips (zone.mq04.far-side), the drips a decal from the workshop to the leech water, shown by day and night
a small grove of root and a young Hist (BM&V's Hist static, scaled) behind the hall
the hall cell named the Hall of the Scalded Throne
Kaska-Meen, a tree-minder of the assembly, at her watch by the young Hist, and Ei-Tuja, a travelling Nisswo, at the root's foot, at their posts all day; both band 0

one door pair inside the ship (01Ship) joining its two sections: the cell's one navmesh (0AA666, 353 triangles, one component, x 2382..3478, z 6685..7283) reaches Lilmoth's door 0AA837 (48 units) but no triangle lies within 2954 units of the landing door 23D496 (x 6038, y 5825, z 8054), whose section (with 23D688) has no navmesh; door A at the navmesh's east end by triangle 335 (about x 3295, y 5343, z 7071), door B beside 23D496 (about x 5990, y 5825, z 8054), both doors take BM&V's own Argonian door base (1DE5DF, 01loaddoorArg), exact spots measured at build
a plain root-and-reed seat at the hall's end, swept, with a sweeper's broom; no dais

two of BM&V's own Giant Wasps (base 166381) at the far bend of the marsh way between the landing and the gate, fixed level at band 1, under an enable parent (ref.mq05.way) that MQ05's stage 20 turns on and its ending turns off; the way itself is BM&V's terrain (root and shallows)
'Docks' named Soulrest: a port on the 01Ship coast line
three of the Chapter in the cleared dungeon, among them Bent-Spine (npc.mercantile-coast.lilmoth-divers-yard.night-reed-fence); under one enable parent that TG01's stage 20 turns on (ref.tg01.parent)

one: the thief's drinking friend, Sits-By-The-Water (npc.mercantile-coast.soulrest.tg01-friend), at the drinking spot by the water; under one enable parent that TG01's stage 20 turns on (ref.tg01.parent)
two of the three door pairs into Soulrest's one room are locked with no key, both sides (outer 11ACD3 and 120E95, inner 11ACA1 and 11ABF3), so the house has one way in, by 120E93 and 0E971F
Tilts-The-Jug, the Chapter's teetotal desk at Soulrest, inside the house
BM&V's cell 'Pussbottom' named Pusbottom
the boardwalk awning the thief sleeps under and a drinking spot by the water, from BM&V's own statics

the thief, Keeps-What-Floats (npc.mercantile-coast.soulrest.tg01-thief), confidence Cowardly so he flees when caught (no script); his round as three packages: the dock and boardwalk by day, the drinking spot by the water in the evening, asleep under the boardwalk awning at night; he carries the keepsake (item.tg01.jasper-necklace, a necklace of polished blue jaspers) on him all the while; under one enable parent that TG01's stage 20 turns on (ref.tg01.parent)
a Khajiit trader on the dock who sells to the Chapter and sends people to Tilts-The-Jug's door
the trapdoor down to the Chapter (16BF7F, just north of Pusbottom) is locked at Novice from the outside, no key; the door inside (16C05B) is not locked

three clients on the canal front by the fallen house: Neeta-Haj (npc.mercantile-coast.lilmoth.tg02-clutch-client), Okan-Tei (npc.mercantile-coast.lilmoth.tg02-charm-client) and Dar-Zeel (npc.mercantile-coast.lilmoth.tg02-beads-client); under one enable parent that TG02's stage 20 turns on (ref.tg02.parent)
ripper eels, Slaughterfish (023AB8:Skyrim.esm) placed in the Pusbottom canal at a fixed level, no patrol path; timing and stealth pass them

a stilt house fallen from its stilts onto the canal floor, from BM&V's own Argonian house statics only (0006), and beside it in the open a locked lockbox (a container, lock Apprentice) holding a worn bone figurine (item.tg02.bone-figurine), a newly mounted Neesak charm (item.tg02.neesak-charm) and a strand of Kothringi Glass Beads (item.glass-bead-strand); under one enable parent that TG02's stage 20 turns on (ref.tg02.parent)

in the ship's hold, on its floor at the far side of the hold from Dives-Without-A-Rope's standing place, under an enable parent off at the start that MQ01's ending (the join line, spoken in Salts-The-Catch's house, another interior) switches on: a sack (a container) she owns, locked (Novice), holding one quest item, the cutters' jar of Hist sap (BM&V's own small jar model); its key in her inventory; five lockpicks, not owned, on the floor beside it (MQ03)
